data = [
    ("C001", "Asha", "Bhopal"),
    ("C002", "Rahul", "Indore"),
    ("C003", "Priya", "Pune")
]

columns = ["customer_id", "customer_name", "city"]

source_df = spark.createDataFrame(data, columns)

source_df.show()

silver_path = "abfss://synapse-filename@synapase.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/Customer.csv"
gold_path = "abfss://synapse-filename@synapase.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/customer_scd2_demo"

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

silver_df = (
    source_df
    .withColumn("start_date", F.current_date())
    .withColumn("end_date", F.lit(None).cast("date"))
    .withColumn("is_current", F.lit(True))
)

silver_df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").save(silver_path)

gold_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, gold_path)

gold_table.alias("tgt").merge(
    silver_df.alias("src"),
    "tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id AND tgt.is_current = true"
).whenNotMatchedInsert(
    values={
        "customer_id": "src.customer_id",
        "customer_name": "src.customer_name",
        "city": "src.city",
        "start_date": "current_date()",
        "end_date": "CAST(NULL AS DATE)",
        "is_current": "true"
    }
).execute()
